import sys, random, json, importlib.util
sys.path.insert(0, "/workspace/tests")
import refmodel
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("submain", "/workspace/submission/main.py")
m = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(m)

def canon(s):
    if s == '.': return '.'
    return '.'.join(l.lower() for l in s[:-1].split('.')) + '.'

ALL = ["a.t.","b.t.","c.t.","x.y.t.","t.","*.t.","d.e.t.","q.*.t.","z.t.","sub.t.",
       "w.sub.t.","*.sub.t.","other.","deep.a.b.t.","n.","*.","loop1.t.","loop2.t."]

def gen_zone(rng, origin):
    owners = [o for o in ALL if origin == '.' or o == origin or o.endswith('.'+origin)]
    others = [o for o in ALL if not (origin == '.' or o == origin or o.endswith('.'+origin))]
    recs = []
    used = {}
    n = rng.randint(0, 6)
    for _ in range(n):
        owner = rng.choice(owners + others)
        if owner == origin:
            continue
        ty = rng.choice(["A","AAAA","TXT","CNAME"])
        if ty == "CNAME":
            target = rng.choice(ALL)
            if used.get(owner, {}).get('CNAME') is not None:
                if used[owner]['CNAME'] != target: continue
            if used.get(owner) and set(used[owner]) - {'CNAME'}: continue
            used.setdefault(owner, {})['CNAME'] = target
            recs.append({"owner":owner,"type":"CNAME","data":target})
        else:
            if used.get(owner) and 'CNAME' in used[owner]: continue
            if ty == "A": data = "%d.%d.%d.%d" % tuple(rng.randint(0,255) for _ in range(4))
            elif ty == "AAAA": data = "2001:db8::%d" % rng.randint(0,9)
            else: data = "t%d" % rng.randint(0,99)
            used.setdefault(owner, {})[ty] = data
            recs.append({"owner":owner,"type":ty,"data":data})
    return {"origin":origin,"records":recs}

total = 0
for seed in range(20):
    rng = random.Random(1000+seed)
    for trial in range(2000):
        origins = ["t.","sub.t.","."]
        rng.shuffle(origins)
        nzones = rng.randint(1,3)
        zones = [gen_zone(rng, origins[i]) for i in range(nzones)]
        profiles = [{"id":"p%d"%i,"max_aliases":rng.randint(0,4),
                     "cname":rng.choice(["follow","stop"]),
                     "wildcard":rng.choice(["rfc","off","one-label"])} for i in range(rng.randint(1,5))]
        queries = [{"id":"q%d"%i,"name":rng.choice(ALL),"type":rng.choice(["A","AAAA","TXT","CNAME"]),
                    "cost":rng.randint(1,9)} for i in range(rng.randint(0,6))]
        doc = {"zones":zones,"profiles":profiles,"queries":queries,"observations":[]}
        out = m.analyze(json.dumps(doc).encode())
        assert 'error' not in out, ("unexpected invalid", json.dumps(doc))
        rz = refmodel.build(zones)
        for q in queries:
            for p in profiles:
                r = refmodel.run(q['name'], q['type'], p, rz)
                got = [x for x in out['runs'] if x['query']==q['id'] and x['profile']==p['id']][0]
                assert (r[0],r[1],r[2],r[3],r[4]) == (got['rcode'],got['termination'],got['final_name'],got['answer'],got['trace']), \
                    (json.dumps(doc), r, got)
        total += 1
print("extended cross-check OK on", total, "documents")
PYEOF
